title: enform instance.undone@1 event payload
description: The payload of an instance.undone@1 event (S13, WF-5, I4, I14): the compensating event that undoes a withdrawal or a cancellation within the flow's undo period. It names the instance, which close it undoes, and the step and holder it restores. The close event stays on the log unchanged (I4).

instanceId.description: The id of the instance that the undo acts on (DX-1).

undoOf.description: The close that this event undoes (WF-5).

step.description: The step that the undo restores as the current step (WF-5).

holder.description: The holder that the undo restores (AS-2); absent when the closed task had nobody.
